name: Index card bookend (the film opens and closes on its contents)

source.description: 1 inspected reference film (batch-6, 2026-11-26): a chaptered type reel opens on an index card listing its chapters and returns to it at the end, completed with an icon per chapter.

technique: The film opens on a card that lists its chapters, plays each chapter as a short self-contained piece, and returns to the same card at the end, now completed with an icon per chapter. The card states the promise; the return proves it was kept.
purpose: State the film's promise up front and prove it was kept: the return to the completed card closes the loop.
visual_behaviour: A card with a title and four chapter rows flips in and holds; a detail of the card (its accent full stop) starts chapter 1; at the end the film cuts back to the card, the title reassembles and each row now carries an icon.
mechanics: Card on a contrasting surround with corner marks; enters with a perspective flip (0.10-0.45 s); four chapter rows; holds about 1.5 s; the first chapter starts from a detail of the card (its accent full stop grows at 1.82 s, cut at 1.87 s). End: cut back to the card (13.13 s); the title's letters reassemble over 0.35 s (13.15-13.48 s); each row now carries an icon; hold about 1.5 s.

decomposition.timing: Card about 1.9 s at each end; chapters of 2.7-4.6 s.

parameters.name: cardHold
parameters.description: Seconds the card holds at each end

failure_modes: More than about five rows will not read in 1.5 s
Returning to an unchanged card wastes the bookend

implementation.approach: A card in Studio.comp.heroStage with a CSS 3D flip in (0.35 s); hold about 1.5 s; start chapter 1 from a detail of the card (bloom from its accent full stop); at the end cut back to the same card, reassemble the title over about 0.35 s and add one icon per row; hold about 1.5 s. The progress-stepper composition is the closest component; not built.

provenance.observed: An index card with a name and four chapter rows flips in (0.10-0.45 s), its orange full stop starts chapter 1 (1.82-1.87 s), and the film cuts back to the card at 13.13 s where the name reassembles and each row gains an icon (14.69 s).
